Khalid bin al-Walid Mosque

📍 Khan Younis, khan-younis
Mosque khan-younis 1995 destroyed

Large mosque in Khan Younis named after companion of Prophet Muhammad. Completely destroyed by airstrike 8 November 2023. Served as major worship center for southern Gaza. Rubble and debris all that remains.
